verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs emphasize continuous, automated monitoring, alerts, and evidence collection (sprinto-docs-3, sprinto-docs-12, sprinto-docs-25) plus AI-editable ingestion workflows (sprinto-docs-26), implying underlying recurring/scheduled compliance checks. However, there is no explicit documentation of a user- or AI-agent-configurable scheduler (cron-like intervals, job frequency settings, or API to create/manage recurring workflows) that an AI-native user could invoke directly. Missing for 10: explicit scheduling/cron API or UI for defining custom recurring job cadence, and any AI-agent-facing endpoint to programmatically schedule workflows.
